summary: Focused retest of the 2 failures from iteration 176, at 390px as test-admin-1 / main. The boat was backed up to /tmp/bk177/boat.json, seeded with /tmp/seed175.py, checked with /tmp/chk175b.py, and restored with mongoimport --mode=upsert (checked: legs None, arrive {}, underway {}). PASSED: (A) DEPART, then ARRIVED (Mooring), then New departure Tawa Bay to Picton Marina (Leave Mooring, 23:45) and ARRIVED (Berth), then Leave Berth Picton Marina to Anatohia Bay and ARRIVED (Drop Anchor). After every ARRIVED, arrival-collapsed-summary says 'Adequate Fuel, LPG, Water. Arrival status logged.' with no 'Changed since it was copied.'. This was still true after a page reload. The log entries say 'Used on the passage Mana Marina to Tawa Bay', 'Tawa Bay to Picton Marina' and 'Picton Marina to Anatohia Bay'. boat.arrive.leg = {start: 'Picton Marina', dest: 'Anatohia Bay'} and log_sig matches. (B) After the arrival status entry was deleted (checklist-item-delete-<id> + Delete), the ARRIVED window's all-done-step-status says 'Copy the arrival levels and what was used into the Ship's Log: ...'. (C) Regression: Weigh Anchor Anatohia Bay to Mana Marina, then Returning to Dock ARRIVED. The window shows 'Fold this trip's 4 legs'. The result is one Trip entry 'Trip - Route Plan: Route Planning - Mana Marina to Mana Marina, 14/11/2026 - 4 legs' with legs 1-4, the right kinds and the right arrivals. Only the 2 unrelated entries stay in the log. Afterwards depart={}, arrive={}, legs.routeHazards=[] and underway={}. Leaving Dock is no longer collapsed. One LOW cosmetic issue is left: the optional part of the iteration 176 B finding was not done.

ui_bugs.component: ArrivalCheck collapsed card after its Ship's Log entry is deleted
ui_bugs.issue: arrival-collapsed-summary still says 'Arrival status logged.' (collapsed and ticked) after the copied entry was deleted from the Ship's Log, because ArrivalCheck only checks arrive.log_id and not whether the id is still in shipsLog. The ARRIVED window now correctly says 'Copy', so this is only cosmetic. DepartureCheck very likely has the same issue.

action_items: LOW (optional): pass shipsLog to ArrivalCheck/DepartureCheck, so the collapsed 'logged' state needs arrive.log_id / depart.log_id to still be in the Ship's Log.
critical_code_review_comments: The ArrivalCheck 'New arrival' button (arrival-reset-btn) sets arrive={}, which also drops arrive.leg. After an interim leg's ARRIVED, a 'New arrival' then re-copy, before the next departure, would use the overall route_start/route_dest in 'Used on the passage ...'. This is an edge case. Consider keeping leg when resetting: onBoatChange('arrive', arrive.leg ? { leg: arrive.leg } : {}).

arrive(): `lb !== b` decides whether to save the leg. It works because legBoat returns b itself only when there is no interim leg and no arrive.leg, but this relies on object identity. An explicit flag would be clearer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested repros (A legs 2 and 3, B, fold regression)
